data.action: 用木搅棒轻搅虹吸壶上层咖啡，另一手扶稳杯子。
data.description: 栞那穿白衬衫、深色马甲和围裙，站在咖啡馆柜台边观察虹吸壶。金属支架托着下方圆形玻璃烧瓶，上方是竖直透明玻璃筒，两层之间以细玻璃管相连。她用木棒轻轻搅拌上层咖啡，另一只手扶着台边的干净杯子，粉色眼睛认真追随旋动的液面。
data.promptProse: Kanna watches the cafe siphon closely, stirring coffee in its upright upper glass cylinder with a wooden stick while her other hand steadies a clean cup on the counter. A thin glass tube joins the cylinder to the round lower flask supported by a metal stand. Her white blouse, waistcoat and apron remain in medium view. Soft frontal morning light reveals the moving liquid, glass contours and polished support against the shaded counter.
data.title: 明月栞那 · 虹吸壶里的晨光
